title: Strong coherent tensor reduction normalized by the forward augmentation
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $X$ be a scheme on whose residue fields $\ell$ is invertible. Use the completed coefficient sheaf of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], the ordinary signed tensor $S_X$ and good (flat-term K-flat) representatives of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation], and the specified chain augmentation of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-chain]. Write $L_X\dashv R_X$ for the coherent reduction/total-limit adjunction of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], with unit $\eta_X$, and write $t_X$ for its tensor on the derived sequence site. Let $T_X$ be completed tensor and $d_X:T_X\simeq t_X(L_X-,L_X-)R_X$ its full strict-model realization from [lem-pur-integral-tensor-roos-realization]. There exists a natural isomorphism $b_X:L_XS_X\simeq t_X(L_X-,L_X-)$ such that, for every natural transformation $\tau:S_X\to T_X$ whose equation on every good representative is exactly the localization of the specified tensor chain augmentation, and every pair of ambient derived objects $M,N$, one has $\tau(M,N);d_X(M,N)=\eta_X(S_X(M,N));R_X(b_X(M,N))$. The comparison is in fact unique, as proved by the adjunct Hom bijection in tensorReductionAugmentation_existsUnique. No geometric inverse image or tensor/pullback square occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: Use integralRingedModelExistence to obtain an existing representative-normalized ordinary tensor presentation d. Restrict d.tensor.ordinary.representative to good complexes and compare it with tensorRepresentativeIso. Fully faithful whiskering by the product of good-complex localizations descends their composite to an isomorphism e from the ordinary tensor to d.tensor.ordinary.tensor, preserving every representative map. Compose e with d.tensorClosed, whisker by reduction, and compose with reductionTensor to construct b.

The supplied ringed tensor chain equals StrictTensorAugmentation.map by its full-coordinate uniqueness, and map_app and tensorCompletionChain_app identify that chain with the specified tensor completion chain. Transport the supplied canonical augmentation by e. Its representative equation is exactly TensorAugmentationNormalized. The product localization is faithful, so every normalized tau equals this transported augmentation: cancel the ordinary representative and completed-tensor comparison on each good pair.

Use the already proved private tensor_augmentation_onGood helper from PrimitiveQuotientAugmentations (whose proof uses tensorQuotientTranspose_onGood and cancels the full Roos model and ordinary representative) to get the prescribed unit-transpose formula on good pairs for the supplied ringed tensor. Naturality of the adjunction unit along e gives the formula for the transported augmentation and b. Faithfulness of the product localization extends this equality of natural transformations to all derived pairs. Existing tensorCompletionComparison and injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection give the unchanged uniqueness corollary.

theorem tensorReductionAugmentation_exists (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] :
    ∃ b : (tensorModel l E X).tensor ⋙ (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction ≅
        ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction.prod
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction) ⋙
            (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor,
      ∀ (τ : (tensorModel l E X).tensor ⟶ integralCompletedTensor l E X),
        TensorAugmentationNormalized l E X τ →
        ∀ M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E X),
          τ.app (M, N) ≫ (pullbackTensorIntegralTensorModel l E X).hom.app (M, N) =
            (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
                ((tensorModel l E X).tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
              (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map (b.hom.app (M, N))
